select * from ( SELECT rj.JOB_ID jobId , rj.JOB_NAME jobName , rj.LOOP_DATE_DETAIL loopDateDetail, rj.START_DATE startDate, rj.END_DATE endDate, rj.LOOP_DATE_VALUE as loopDateValue, P.START_DATE as execDate FROM rep_job rj LEFT JOIN ( select T.JOB_ID, T.START_DATE, T.Sequence from ( SELECT a.JOB_ID, a.START_DATE, IF ( @JOB_ID = a.JOB_ID, @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1 ) AS Sequence , @JOB_ID := a.JOB_ID
FROM ( SELECT * FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG WHERE START_DATE IS NOT NULL ) a, ( SELECT @rownum := 0, @JOB_ID := NULL, @rank := 0 ) b )T where T.Sequence<=1 ) P ON P.JOB_ID=rj.JOB_ID WHERE 1=1
AND rj.JOB_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{jobName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND rj.JOB_ID IN
#{item}
ORDER BY rj.UPDATE_TIME desc ) where 1=1
